subject: Reinstall fipindicateur and re-arm autostart entry
learnings: make install never touches autostart: the app writes it via SetAutostart. When editing the entry by hand, match the app's output byte-for-byte so they never fight.

subject: Set up gnome-shell watchdog that auto-kills fipindicateur
learnings: A D-Bus property read on org.gnome.Shell dispatches on the shell's main loop, so it times out exactly when the session is wedged, even at low CPU. Also: a kill-by-name watchdog cannot be live-fire tested while the real app is running; test detection with no-kill thresholds instead.

subject: Per-station colors for stats report bars
learnings: radiofrance.fr publishes official per-webradio colors as CSS tokens (--webradio-fix-fip-*), first-party and unconditional. Brand palettes are not chart palettes: clamp per theme to 3:1 contrast (mix toward black/white), and let direct labels carry identity (Hip-Hop and Metal officially share one purple).

subject: Tray icon tinted with active station color (10s gradient)
learnings: The tray icon was already an animated VU meter, so tinting rides existing frames with zero new SetIcon sites. Quantize any transition (16 steps) so the frame cache stays bounded and a zap costs a bounded number of icon updates: the 2026-07-09 freeze was unbounded churn, not animation per se.

subject: Crossfade entre stations (3-5s) au zap
learnings: mpv has no native crossfade; the trick is two libmpv handles with role swap, ramping mpv's INTERNAL volume only. Never ramp ao-volume: PulseAudio stream-restore would persist the fade level as the user's app volume. Same-station fades (quality toggle) phase/echo because two icecast connections never share a live edge: stop first.

subject: Windows 80/20: build tags + cross-compile .exe
learnings: The macOS _other.go build-tag discipline made GOOS=windows nearly free (only open/relaunch missing). The real 20%: cgo needs a windows-tagged file to carry explicit CFLAGS/LDFLAGS because a shared '#cgo pkg-config:' line applies to every platform; and fyne/systray wants ICO on Windows, satisfied by a 22-byte PNG-in-ICO wrapper (Vista+) at the single SetIcon chokepoint.

subject: Reglage crossfade au menu + slider volume zenity
learnings: SNI tray menus cannot host sliders; zenity --scale --print-partial gives a real live-drag slider with zero Go deps (stdlib exec, LookPath-gated). Apply per tick but record telemetry once on OK; set cfg before SetVolume so the ao-volume observer echo is swallowed by the equal-value guard.

subject: Taste signals: explicit like/dislike (events + prefs.jsonl + tray UI)
learnings: a.on records the behaviour event BEFORE the handler runs, so state-gated items must stay Disabled until valid or you log ghost events with no prefs entry.

subject: tools/enrich companion: Wikidata + embeddings + 2D projection
learnings: model2vec static multilingual embeddings + sklearn t-SNE handle a ~280-point artist map with no torch; caching every raw API response made the rerun cost 3 requests instead of 473.

subject: Design direction + DESIGN.md (Fin d emission)
learnings: Editorial-typographic is itself a saturated AI lane; singularity came from a physical scene (tuner glow at 2am) plus ONE committed color (FIP rose) and a named kicker system (the conducteur) that earns its numbering.

subject: SPA build-time toolchain (esbuild + D3 + subsetted WOFF2)
learnings: Commit the generated .tmpl so go build stays node-free, and make the bundler assert its own invariants (__FIP_DATA__ count, em-dash ban) so drift fails at build not at lint.

subject: Extended stats derivation (epochs, enriched, tastes)
learnings: Parallel worktree agents branched pre-merge recreate shared packages (internal/prefs was born twice); state the exact base commit in briefs or sequence the merges.

subject: Fin d emission report page (9 segments, 4 new dataviz)
learnings: SVG marker arrowheads scale with stroke-width and markerUnits=userSpaceOnUse is unreliable in chromium; draw fixed-size heads from the curve end tangent instead.

subject: Final integration: merges, e2e verify on real data, CHANGELOG
learnings: Whole-tree lint greps break on untracked toolchain dirs (node_modules, .venv) left by worktree agents; exclude them in the gate itself and mirror the exclusion in CI.

subject: Chromecast casting: stdlib mDNS + CASTV2, tray submenu
learnings: CASTV2 is hand-rollable: 6-field protobuf over TLS + JSON payloads; contentType must track stream quality (audio/mpeg vs audio/aacp).

subject: Blind review of cast feature
learnings: Code review + green tests prove wiring, not product: every hardware-facing milestone needed one more fix after meeting the real device.

subject: Release v0.4.0
learnings: release.yml is tag-triggered and publishes itself: create tag, let CI publish, then gh release edit; gh release create races it.

subject: Fix mDNS discovery + slow-AVR handshake, fip cast scan
learnings: Real cast devices ignore legacy unicast mDNS queries: QU bit AND multicast-group listener both needed; AVRs cold-boot their cast module on LAUNCH (8.2s warm measured) so the status wait needs ~30s.

subject: Le panneau: webkit2gtk quick-control drawer
learnings: cgo shim straight on webkit2gtk (libmpv precedent) beats a Go module; GTK on one LockOSThread goroutine + g_idle_add marshaling coexists with DBus SNI; CSS [hidden] loses to any display rule (specificity trap that blanked a whole view).

subject: SNI single-UI refactor + test belt
learnings: GNOME appindicator: Activate only fires on DOUBLE-click; a missing IconAccessibleDesc property silently drops the icon; Menu=/NO_DBUSMENU hides the item (export a dead menu path); synthetic X wheel events are not forwarded (smooth-scroll only). Test hygiene: brand mock windows visibly or they haunt the real UI.

subject: CI upgrade + v0.5.0 ship
learnings: Headless 'light' captures inherit desktop gsettings: determinism needs explicit --light/--dark flags; screenshot artifacts turn design QA into a CI gate.

subject: Amplification DSP (préampli + limiteur) au menu et au panneau
learnings: FIP streams measure -18.5 LUFS with LRA 2.4 LU (already broadcast-compressed): static preamp + alimiter beats loudnorm, which would only add latency to a constant gain. The gain stage must precede the @astats tap in the af graph or the VU icon reads pre-gain levels; alimiter needs level=disabled or it re-normalizes output toward 0 dBFS and the ceiling disappears.

subject: Chasse aux bugs UX/état: volume fantôme, cast invisible, dial en vol, readout du curseur
learnings: ao-volume rapporte 0 pendant un battement après l'ouverture du flux (avant que PulseAudio n'applique le niveau restauré): ne jamais faire confiance à un rapport lu à PLAYBACK_RESTART, passer par une fenêtre de grâce + relecture posée. Le signal d'écoute doit suivre l'oreille (audible() = flux local OU session cast avec media playing), pas le processus local; la dérivation stats connaît cast_start/stop/pause/resume. Un dial cast en vol est invisible aux tests d'état: toute intention locale de transport doit l'annuler (castDialGen). Vérifier ses propres diagnostics avant de corriger: la ligne « confirmations armées effacées par un push » était fausse (les rows danger sont du HTML statique, jamais reconstruites).

subject: PROTO A: le menu SNI maison devient toute l'interface Linux
learnings: Porter ui_menu.go sur le dbusmenu maison se joue sur trois pièges: (1) le menuItem Linux doit rester nil-safe sur CHAQUE mutateur (les tests construisent des App nus et les entonnoirs de ui.go appellent sans garde; le struct{} no-op d'avant le garantissait); (2) un sync.Mutex ne se copie pas: mnu := m.it.menu puis mnu.mu.Lock(), jamais mu := m.it.menu.mu (go vet attrape); (3) gdbus call lit -1 comme une option: il faut le séparateur -- avant les arguments. Pour vérifier un SNI à côté d'une instance de production: l'instance tient le flock de XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (PID trouvé par lsof sur le fichier de verrou, jamais par nom), MPRIS refuse le doublon, donc stop propre, test, puis gtk-launch pour restaurer.

subject: Roue editoriale des genres pour le zap precedent/suivant
learnings: Le cercle de zap etait l'ordre brut de stations.All (5 accords dissonants sur 13). Decision: roue editoriale de 6 duos affines + FIP a la couture (All reste canonique, Wheel() facade la navigation, menus en ordre de roue). Le voisinage data-driven (Held-Karp sur les arêtes station_change symetrisees, ~1,4M etats pour 13 noeuds) est differe jusqu'a assez de sessions: stats opt-in desactive sur le Mac, log complet sur le XPS omon + sauvegarde domovoy (volume bloque par blind-guard, data plus tard). TestWheelIsPermutation a attrape aussitot une cle inventee (monde vs world): le garde-fou paie sa place des le premier commit.

subject: Release v0.8.0 (roue des genres + tray natif macOS)
learnings: Le workflow release/ci epinglait un asset shinchiro mpv-dev purge en amont (404 depuis octobre): curl sans -f fabriquait un mpv-dev.7z de 9 octets et le message 7z 'Is not archive' cachait la vraie cause. Repin + curl -fL --retry 3. Pieges de la seance: (1) rg -rn n'est pas -n, c'est --replace n (fausse alerte rtk); (2) un pipe apres gh run watch --exit-status avale le code de sortie: watcher en fond SANS pipe, jamais; (3) destructive-guard refuse --force tag: delete+push du tag plutot, le run rate n'ayant cree aucun objet release.

subject: Sprint chasse aux bugs d'etat: icone animee qui s'arrete + races
learnings: L'icone qui 's'arrete' etait un etat zombie: END_FILE ne faisait que journaliser, playing restait true, IsPlaying mentait, le menu aussi. Le fix structurant est un callback StreamEnded filtre par raison (eof/erreur, pas nos stop) + resync via setPlayingUI; tout le reste (double clic play, station morte inclicable) tombe gratis. Les 'autres bugs d'etat' etaient surtout des races sans verrou: config ecrite depuis le goroutine mpv, lue par l'animateur, retournee par les clics. Pattern qui tient: snapshot (cfgSnapshot/currentStation) plutot que verrouiller chaque acces. -race sur les paquets touches, pas partout: c'est lui qui fera foi au prochain cycle.

task: tray icon colors: Legible keeps full HSL saturation (lightness-only nudge for 3:1), black phantom rim under colored ink, white rim kept for neutral inks; docs strip/gif now composite the real rim pixels
SwiftUI popover M1: action registry (App.fire) shared by menu and popover, Swift linked into the Go binary behind the swiftui tag, left click opens the popover
learning: Linking Swift into a cgo binary: ship one -wmo object as a .syso (hashed by the build cache, an -l archive is not), move __LLVM,__swift_modhash out with ld -r -rename_section (ld -r alone keeps it for a single input, Go rejects it as LTO), and tag every Go file of the syso package or the default go test ./... trips on it. Not verified: real clicks on the live popover.

task: SwiftUI popover M2: landscape card pinned top-right under the menu bar (real cover, latched verdict waves, VU fader, draggable and throwable dial), banners skipped while it is up
learning: An NSPopover anchored to a status item fights the menu bar; a borderless non-activating NSPanel placed from screen.visibleFrame is simpler and behaves like a menu once outside-click monitors close it. For gestures in SwiftUI, make the moving view Animatable on one scalar so a throw is drawn as a scroll. An offscreen NSHostingView render behind a TestMain that pins the main thread lets a layout be looked at without clicking. Not verified: real drag/throw feel and outside-click dismissal on the live card.

task: SwiftUI popover M3: Réglages window (native grouped Form) fed by the snapshot, every setting registered as an action, right-click menu shrunk to a short list in the card build
learning: Shrinking a menu whose handlers tick their own checkboxes: keep building the submenus and Hide() them, so no handler meets a nil item and the default build is untouched. A stateless settings form is a Binding whose get reads the snapshot and whose set only sends an action. A fixed-pitch dial overlaps long names: lay stations out by measured label width and route drag and throw through the same scale. Not verified: the live window (focus as an accessory app, confirmation dialogs, hidden menu items).

task: Réglages on the back of the card (flip, two pages), four-bar meter shared with the tray, WEBSITE.md brief
learning: A second window in an accessory (tray) app does not reliably come forward: put the secondary surface inside the panel already on screen (a flip of the same size) and avoid anything that opens its own window (Picker, confirmationDialog) since the outside-click monitor would close the card. Two readers of one animation: compute the frame once in the loop, hand each reader the same heights only when its copy is stale, and let the loop outlive the tray setting while the card is up. Not verified live: the flip, the page slide, the meter sync.

task: Card shortcuts and auto-hide, carton d'antenne, preset ladders removed from the card build
learning: A toast panel that must never steal keys: borderless nonactivating NSPanel with canBecomeKey false and ignoresMouseEvents, fed one self-contained payload per banner (cover path, station colour) so it cannot show the previous track, and suppressed while the card is up. Idle auto-hide is cheapest as a 1 s timer polling NSEvent.mouseLocation against the panel frame. Gate removal of menu ladders on the card-build constant, not on darwin: the default macOS build has no card and keeps them; nil preset maps are safe to range over but a title-writing item (mCrossfade) must still exist. Not verified live: keys, auto-hide timing, carton entrance, the trimmed menu.
Un banner de zap doit nommer sa destination (Station/Color) car a.current ne change qu'en startStation ; une hauteur fixe évite le fittingSize périmé d'un panel réutilisé.
Offscreen render table needs a per-row snapshot tweak (verdict) to eyeball latched states; SourceKit single-file errors on Views.swift are noise, swiftc build is the truth.
